title: PBA: Abarrientos fires 34 as Ginebra halts Rain or Shine’s four-game win streak
summary: RJ Abarrientos’ red-hot shooting powered Ginebra past Rain or Shine, 129-111, to secure just their third win in the PBA Season 50 Governors’ Cup, Friday at the Ninoy Aquino Stadium.
